ideas.title: Insurers can run legacy code war rooms on local models instead of token budgets
ideas.connection: GEICO's talk frames $1,000 a day in tokens for legacy code work, and an MIT-licensed local coding model plus a deterministic code knowledge graph could do much of that work in-house.

ideas.title: Inference resellers can quote open MoE serving on TPU capacity, not only GPUs
ideas.connection: TorchTPU lets existing SGLang serving code run on TPUs, and Beam 1.0 is a speed-focused open MoE that teams can download and run, so one serving stack can now be priced on two kinds of hardware.

ideas.title: SaaS vendors can turn agent security audits into ready compliance evidence trails
ideas.connection: Verified machine-readable audit findings, a hard human-approval gate, and agent config kept as reviewed YAML together produce the who-checked-what record auditors ask for.

ideas.title: Canadian public bodies can split AI work into hosted and strictly in-country tiers
ideas.connection: GPT models are now callable on Bedrock from Canadian regions but cross-Region inference may route data out, while DeepInfer lets teams self-host DeepSeek at scale inside their own boundary.

ideas.title: Small dev agencies can make a single 5090 a usable coding agent tier
ideas.connection: The 1.66 bpw Qwen quant is fast but has a small context window, and context-mode's output trimming plus OpenHands per-profile settings work around exactly that constraint.

ideas.title: Teen-facing apps can add a local conversation-level safety monitor and prove it works
ideas.connection: Clef answers typed questions about JSON state locally, and SAFE-Teen scores safety across whole multi-turn conversations, so a monitor that watches full transcripts can be built and measured.

ideas.title: Compliance training teams can ship localized video variants from templated agent output
ideas.connection: Strict JSON from Claude on Bedrock fills a fixed HTML template, which avoids the measured high token cost of free-form HTML; Hyperframes renders that HTML to video and VoiceStudio adds local voiceover per language.

ideas.title: Engineering leads can target comprehension checks where the agent actually struggled
ideas.connection: AgentPlay's replay shows which files, subagents and errors an agent run involved, and Sphinx can aim its pre-push questionnaire at exactly those spots instead of the whole diff.

ideas.title: City and health hotlines can serve minority-language callers on self-hosted voice bots
ideas.connection: A local voice suite in 646 languages, a self-hosted call center with bot-to-human handoff, and a very fast cheap diffusion LLM together make low-latency multilingual phone service possible without sending audio to a hosted API.

ideas.title: Orphaned smart devices can be revived as local products when vendor clouds shut down
ideas.connection: Agent-assisted binary and app analysis, AI help on hardware reverse engineering, and the Echo Dot local conversion precedent turn cloud-dependent devices into a refurbish-and-relaunch opportunity.

threats.title: MCP TypeScript SDK experimental tasks leak across sessions
threats.headline: Clients sharing an MCP SDK task store could list, read and cancel each other's experimental tasks.

threats.title: MCP TypeScript SDK bearer auth skips token audience check
threats.headline: MCP servers using SDK bearer auth could accept tokens issued for other services by the same authorization server.

threats.title: MCP TypeScript client SDK leaks headers on cross-origin redirects
threats.headline: MCP SDK clients followed cross-origin redirects, sending API keys, session IDs and OAuth secrets to other origins.
